text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq and Russia are holding talks to set up a joint company to excavate oil fields in Iraq.
- National Assembly is briefed on talks with foreign firms to improve al-Ahdab oil field in Iraq.
- Jordanian Ports Establishment cuts tariff on goods heading for Iraq.
- Qatari foreign minister meets Iraqi ambassador in Doha.
- Deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz meets a delegation from the Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine.
(The last two stories were also carried by QADISSIYA and IRAQ)
